en: Mei. Take this to Mrs. Wong.
zh_HK: 阿美，攞呢包藥去畀黃婆婆。

en: She won't come down for it herself. Stubborn woman.
zh_HK: 佢唔肯自己落嚟攞。硬頸婆。

en: He puts his old instant camera in your hands.
zh_HK: 他把那部舊即影即有相機放到你手上。

en: You'll forget what things looked like.
zh_HK: 你會唔記得啲嘢以前係咩樣。

en: Follow the blue pipe. When you reach Lau's place, go up.
zh_HK: 跟住條藍色水喉行。去到劉醫生嗰度，就上樓。

en: Blue pipe. Lau's. Up. Go on.
zh_HK: 藍色水喉。劉醫生。上樓。去啦。

en: Then why are you standing here?
She said to tell you she's not leaving before you do.
zh_HK: 佢叫我同你講，你未走，佢唔會走先。

en: He turns the radio up a little.
zh_HK: 他把收音機調大了一點。

en: Your mother saved you some rice. Kit came back and ate half of it.
zh_HK: 你阿媽留咗飯畀你。阿潔又嚟過，食咗一半。

en: She said she'd tell you herself.
Medicine first. Then you can help me with these.
zh_HK: 送咗藥先。返嚟幫我執埋呢啲。

en: Grandfather, young, in a crowd of people you don't know.
zh_HK: 年輕的公公，站在一群你不認識的人中間。

en: Cardboard boxes, taped shut. Your mother's handwriting on the sides.
zh_HK: 一個個用膠紙封好的紙皮箱，側面寫著媽媽的字。
廚房。　冬衣。　收音機。

en: Mei! Mind the tray, those are clean.
zh_HK: 阿美！小心個盤，嗰啲啱啱洗乾淨㗎。

en: Apparently I'm getting a real office after this. With windows.
zh_HK: 聽講搬咗之後，我會有間正式嘅醫務所。有窗㗎。

en: Thirty-one years in this room and I've never once seen the weather.
zh_HK: 喺呢間房做咗三十一年，一次都未見過出面係咩天氣。
嗰部係咪你公公部相機？

en: Take one of me. With the old chair, before they haul it off.
zh_HK: 同我影張啦。連埋張舊椅，趁佢哋未搬走。

en: Go on, before I change my mind.
zh_HK: 快啲啦，陣間我改變主意。

en: Well? I'm not getting any younger.
zh_HK: 點呀？我唔會越嚟越後生㗎。

en: Wong's upstairs from here, isn't she? The stairs are through the back.
zh_HK: 黃婆婆住喺上面，係咪？樓梯喺後面。

en: You don't work under fluorescent tubes all day.
zh_HK: 你又唔使成日喺光管底下做嘢。

en: Go on. Mrs. Wong won't wait forever.
zh_HK: 去啦。黃婆婆唔會等你一世。

en: Back already? Tell your mother to start packing.
zh_HK: 咁快返嚟？叫你阿媽快啲執嘢。

en: It's still dripping. You can't get past without soaking yourself.
zh_HK: 還在滴水。要過去就一定會弄濕自己。
不知誰家晾的衣服，還是濕的。

en: Mind the washing on the catwalk, Mei.
zh_HK: 阿美，小心天橋上面啲衫。

en: Mrs. Chan, can you move the washing? I need to get to Mrs. Wong's.
zh_HK: 陳太，可唔可以收咗啲衫先？我要過去黃婆婆度。

en: Wai was supposed to carry them upstairs to dry. I haven't seen him all afternoon.
zh_HK: 阿偉應該攞上去晾乾㗎。成個下晝都唔見佢。

en: He's probably gone up to the roof again. With that pigeon man.
zh_HK: 實係又走咗上天台。同嗰個養白鴿嘅阿伯一齊。

en: How do I get up there?
Not by the stairs. That roof door's been stuck for years. Only Wai knows the trick to it.
zh_HK: 唔係行樓梯。天台道門卡死咗好多年，得阿偉識開。

en: He goes up the shaft behind my kitchen. Like a monkey. I don't want to know.
zh_HK: 佢成日喺我廚房後面條天井爬上去。似隻馬騮咁。我唔想知。

en: If you find him, tell him his mother has a wooden spoon.
zh_HK: 搵到佢就同佢講，佢阿媽揸住雞毛掃等緊佢。

en: Wai's up on the roof, helping Mr. Ng.
Of course he is. Tell him his mother has a wooden spoon.
zh_HK: 梗係啦。同佢講，佢阿媽揸住雞毛掃等緊佢。

en: I'll believe it when I see it.
He finally came for them. Go on, it's clear.
zh_HK: 佢終於嚟收咗。過去啦，冇嘢擋喇。

en: The airshaft. A rusted ladder climbs the west wall all the way to the roof.
zh_HK: 天井。一道生鏽的鐵梯沿著西牆，一直通上天台。

en: Its bottom rungs have rusted clean away. The first one is out of reach.
zh_HK: 最下面幾級早已鏽斷，第一級夠不著。

en: The ladder's bottom rungs are gone.
zh_HK: 鐵梯最下面幾級沒有了。

en: That old crate behind the fridge would get you up to them.
zh_HK: 雪櫃後面那個舊木箱，墊著就夠得著。

en: Onto the crate, up to the first rung.
Then straight up, the way Wai must go.
zh_HK: 然後一直爬上去，阿偉一定也是這樣走的。

en: A long drop down the airshaft. You can't see a way down from here.
zh_HK: 天井很深。從這裡看不到下去的路。

en: The roof door is swollen stuck in its frame. It won't budge.
zh_HK: 天台門受潮發脹，卡死在門框裡，推不動。

en: The stairwell door is swollen stuck in its frame. It won't budge.
zh_HK: 樓梯間的門受潮發脹，卡死在門框裡，推不動。

en: Mei? What are you doing up here?
Your mother's looking for you. The washing.
The washing! I was supposed to bring it up hours ago.
zh_HK: 啲衫！我幾個鐘頭前就應該攞上嚟㗎喇。

en: I can't yet. Mr. Ng needs me. One of the birds won't come down.
zh_HK: 但係未得住。吳伯要我幫手，有隻白鴿唔肯落嚟。

en: If she flies off now she might not find the new place.
zh_HK: 佢而家飛走，可能搵唔到新屋。

en: Mei? What are you doing up here?
Is that your family's washing on the catwalk? I can't get past it.
zh_HK: 天橋上面啲衫係咪你屋企㗎？我過唔到。

en: Ma's washing! I was supposed to bring it up hours ago.
zh_HK: 阿媽啲衫！我幾個鐘頭前就應該攞上嚟㗎喇。

en: I can't yet. Mr. Ng needs me. One of the birds won't come down.
zh_HK: 但係未得住。吳伯要我幫手，有隻白鴿唔肯落嚟。

en: If she flies off now she might not find the new place.
zh_HK: 佢而家飛走，可能搵唔到新屋。

en: Go on, take it. He never lets anyone.
zh_HK: 快啲影啦。佢平時唔畀人影㗎。

en: Don't touch, they're still wet. I'm taking them up to the roof.
zh_HK: 唔好掂，仲未乾。我攞上天台晾。

en: She's somewhere up by the water tank. She's scared.
Ma's washing! I forgot again. She's going to kill me.
zh_HK: 阿媽啲衫！我又唔記得咗。佢實劈死我。

en: I'll bring it up here to dry. And I'll get the stair door open for you. There's a trick to it.
zh_HK: 我攞上嚟呢度晾。順便幫你開樓梯道門，有竅門㗎。

en: Don't tell Ma how long it took.
zh_HK: 唔好同阿媽講搞咗幾耐。

en: Mind the birds. They don't like strangers.
zh_HK: 小心啲雀。佢哋唔鍾意生人。

en: Over by the coop, pretending to work.
Hm. Lee's girl. Or is it Leung's.
zh_HK: 唔。李家個女。定係梁家嘅。

en: One of mine's hiding up by the water tank. She won't come down unless she can see the way home.
zh_HK: 我有隻匿咗喺水缸上面。佢睇唔到返屋企嘅路，唔肯落嚟。

en: Find her. Then look at it the way she does.
zh_HK: 搵到佢。然後用佢嘅角度睇吓。

en: Find her first. Then look at it the way she does.
zh_HK: 搵到佢先。然後用佢嘅角度睇吓。

en: A bedsheet, pegged out to dry between the tank and the coop.
zh_HK: 一張床單，用衣夾晾在水缸和雀籠之間。

en: From where she's perched, this sheet hangs right across her view of the coop.
zh_HK: 從牠停著的地方看，這張床單正好擋住了雀籠。

en: Mei unpins one corner and lets it swing aside.
zh_HK: 阿美鬆開一角的衣夾，讓床單擺到一邊。

en: There. See? She knew the way. She only needed to see it.
zh_HK: 係囉。見到未？佢識路嘅，只係要睇得到。

en: They know the way home better than people do.
zh_HK: 佢哋認得返屋企嘅路，仲叻過人。

en: A roar builds somewhere over the rooftops.
zh_HK: 屋頂上空，轟鳴聲越來越近。

en: Well? The birds won't hold still forever.
zh_HK: 點呀？啲雀唔會一直企定定㗎。

en: Tell your grandfather the birds miss him.
zh_HK: 同你公公講，啲雀掛住佢。

en: Tell him I'm not leaving before he does.
zh_HK: 同佢講，佢未走，我唔會走先。

en: Watch the pipe. And tell your grandfather the soup is for him.
zh_HK: 小心條水喉。仲有，同你公公講，啲湯係煲畀佢㗎。

en: Your grandfather looking for you? He owes me forty dollars.
zh_HK: 你公公搵你呀？佢仲欠我四十蚊。

en: Fifty years this fan's been going. Might as well fix it one more time.
zh_HK: 呢把風扇轉咗五十年。都係幫佢整多次啦。

en: Says here they're setting a date.
They've been setting a date since I was your age.
zh_HK: 我好似你咁大個嗰陣，佢哋已經話緊定日子。

en: Don't run on the stairs. My ma says.
zh_HK: 唔好喺樓梯度跑。我阿媽話㗎。

en: Mr. Lau wanted his picture first.
zh_HK: 劉醫生想我先同佢影相。

en: Film is precious. Mei lowers the camera.
zh_HK: 菲林很珍貴。阿美放下相機。

en: Grandfather's radio. Something cheerful, half lost in static.
zh_HK: 公公的收音機。播著輕快的歌，一半淹沒在雜音裡。

en: The old dental chair. The vinyl is patched with tape in three places.
zh_HK: 舊牙醫椅。膠皮上有三處用膠布補過。

en: 劉牙科. Lau Dental. The paint on the sign is older than you are.
zh_HK: 「劉牙科」。招牌上的油漆比你還老。

en: The Housing Department's notice. Everyone has read it. Nobody talks about it.
zh_HK: 房屋署的通告。人人都看過，卻沒有人提起。

en: Mr. Ng's coop. Every bird has a name written on a strip of tape.
zh_HK: 吳伯的雀籠。每隻鴿子都有名字，寫在一小條膠布上。

en: The blue pipe runs straight into the wall.
zh_HK: 藍色水喉直直鑽進了牆裡。

en: Far below, the alley is full of other people's rubbish.
zh_HK: 下面遠處的後巷，堆滿了別人扔下的垃圾。

en: A counter, a gas ring and a wok: the whole kitchen. The tap comes off the blue pipe. Every drop of water in the flat runs through it.
zh_HK: 一個灶台、一個煤氣爐、一個鑊，就是整個廚房。水龍頭從那條藍色水喉分出來，屋裡每一滴水都經過它。

en: A squat toilet behind a curtain, its cistern fed from the same pipe. Most families here share one down the corridor.
zh_HK: 布簾後面是一個蹲廁，水箱也是從同一條水喉接水。這裡大多數人家，都要跟整層人共用走廊上的廁所。

en: Grandfather sleeps below, you sleep on top. Three generations, one room.
zh_HK: 公公睡下格，你睡上格。三代人，一個房間。

en: The cockloft: a platform built up under the ceiling. Mum sleeps up there, beside the cases she has already packed.
zh_HK: 閣樓：在天花板下搭出來的木架。媽媽就睡在上面，旁邊是已經收拾好的行李箱。

en: Mrs. Chan's stove. Above it the Kitchen God keeps watch; at New Year he reports on the family to Heaven.
zh_HK: 陳太的灶頭。上面供著灶君，每到年尾，他要上天稟報這一家人的事。

en: Mrs. Chan sleeps below, Wai on top, when he comes home.
zh_HK: 陳太睡下格，阿偉睡上格，如果他肯回家的話。

en: The floor's toilet. Every family along this corridor shares it. The bucket is for when the water stops.
zh_HK: 這層樓的廁所，整條走廊的人家共用。停水的時候，就靠旁邊那桶水。

en: One ring, one pot. Cooking for one.
zh_HK: 一個爐頭，一個煲。一個人的飯。

en: An old crate, hidden behind the broken fridge.
zh_HK: 壞雪櫃後面，藏著一個舊木箱。

en: A pigeon, tucked in behind the water tank.
zh_HK: 有隻白鴿縮在水缸後面。

en: There she is, tucked in behind the water tank.
zh_HK: 找到了，牠縮在水缸後面。

en: Film is precious. Frame someone who matters.
zh_HK: 菲林很珍貴。拍一個對你重要的人吧。

en: Graphics: full (shadows, bloom, depth of field)
Bring Grandfather's medicine to Mrs. Wong.
zh_HK: 把公公的藥送去給黃婆婆。

en: Grandfather said to follow the blue pipe.
zh_HK: 公公說，跟著藍色水喉走。

en: Press C to raise the camera.
“When you reach Lau's place, go up.”
Someone's washing is blocking the catwalk.
zh_HK: 有人晾的衣服擋住了天橋。

en: It's still dripping. Whoever hung it lives close by.
zh_HK: 還在滴水。晾衣服的人應該就住在附近。

en: “He's probably gone up to the roof again.”
One of Mr. Ng's pigeons won't come down.
zh_HK: 吳伯有隻白鴿不肯下來。

en: “She won't come down unless she can see the way.”
Wai went to fetch the washing.
Unlicensed dentists and doctors practised inside the Walled City for decades, charging a fraction of Hong Kong prices.
zh_HK: 數十年來，城寨裡有不少無牌牙醫和醫生執業，收費只是城外的零頭。

en: His new clinic will have windows.
The rooftops were the only open space in the city. Residents kept birds, dried laundry and watched planes land at Kai Tak.
zh_HK: 天台是城寨裡唯一的空曠地方。居民在這裡養鳥、晾衫，看飛機降落啟德。

en: Mr. Ng says they know the way home better than people do.
zh_HK: 吳伯說，牠們比人更認得回家的路。
「你會唔記得\n啲嘢以前係咩樣。」

en: Empty pages.\nGrandfather's camera is still full of film.
zh_HK: 空白的頁。\n公公的相機裡，還有很多菲林。

en: Kowloon Walled City, the last weeks before the move. Grandfather needs his medicine taken to Mrs. Wong. A vertical slice, about fifteen minutes. Headphones help.
zh_HK: 九龍城寨，搬遷前的最後幾個星期。公公要你把藥送去給黃婆婆。試玩版，約十五分鐘。建議戴上耳機。

en: Somewhere below, the pump starts up.
Go and find Ho. He'll be in the hall, talking to a pipe.
zh_HK: 去搵何師傅。佢應該喺走廊，同條水喉傾緊偈。

en: Hear that? Water. Now someone can make tea.
zh_HK: 聽到未？有水喇。而家終於有人可以沖茶喇。

en: Go and find Ho. Before your grandfather tries to fix it himself.
zh_HK: 快啲去搵何師傅，趁你公公未自己郁手整。

en: It's back. Go and tell Ho, before he takes the whole pump apart.
zh_HK: 有水喇。快啲去話畀何師傅知，唔係佢成個泵拆晒。

en: Grandpa says the pump sounds wrong.
Pump is working. Water isn't getting where it's going.
zh_HK: 泵冇壞。係啲水去唔到佢要去嘅地方。

en: If I knew that, this would be a shorter conversation.
zh_HK: 我知嘅話，呢單嘢一早傾完喇。

en: He points up with the screwdriver.
Blue branch. Follow it until it stops being blue.
zh_HK: 藍色嗰條支喉。跟住佢行，行到佢唔再係藍色為止。

en: Why does it stop being blue?
Whoever laid it. Nobody built this lot, Mei. Everybody did.
zh_HK: 邊個駁就邊個油。呢度啲水喉冇人起過，阿美。係個個一齊起嘅。

en: Blue. Until it isn't. Go on.
zh_HK: 藍色。跟到佢唔係藍為止。去啦。

en: Blue until it isn't. Very helpful.
zh_HK: 藍到唔係藍為止。真係好有用。

en: From the side it's plain: the faded one only goes down the well to a capped end. The blue one crosses it.
zh_HK: 從側面看就清楚了：褪色那條只是沿天井落到一個封死的管口，藍色那條則橫過天井。

en: And it's the one that knocks when the pump does.
zh_HK: 而且個泵一開，就係佢喺度咚咚聲。

en: Behind the air-conditioners, Mrs. Fong's tap branches off into her wall. The blue pipe doesn't. It keeps going, to the flat next door.
zh_HK: 冷氣機後面，方太的水喉分支鑽進她家牆裡。藍色水喉沒有，它一直伸到隔壁那個單位。

en: (calling up from below) It crosses the light well!
zh_HK: （喺下面叫上嚟）佢橫過天井㗎！

en: It crosses the well. There's the footbridge.
zh_HK: 佢橫過天井。嗰度有條橋。

en: The front's chained. There might be a way in round the back.
zh_HK: 前門鎖住咗。後面可能有路入。

en: The door is chained from the outside.
zh_HK: 門從外面用鐵鏈鎖住了。

en: A Housing Department notice across it: the family has been rehoused. The unit is sealed.
zh_HK: 門上貼著房屋署的通告：住戶已獲安置，單位已封閉。

en: The back kitchen window is off its latch. Mei climbs in over the sill.
zh_HK: 後面廚房的窗沒有扣上。阿美從窗台爬了進去。

en: Somewhere above, water bursts out of a pipe.
zh_HK: 樓上某處，一條水喉噴出水來。

en: The old sink coughs, and coughs, and brings up a gout of brown water.
zh_HK: 舊洗碗盆咳了幾聲，吐出一大口黃泥水。

en: The valve fights her, then gives.
zh_HK: 水掣扭得很緊，然後鬆開了。

en: The pipe shudders. Far below, the pump catches, and holds.
zh_HK: 水喉震了一震。遠遠的樓下，水泵開動，這次沒有再停。

en: They'll shut this riser when Cheung's floor goes.
zh_HK: 張太嗰層搬晒，佢哋就會閂咗呢條總喉。

en: Go home. Your mother's got water again.
zh_HK: 返去啦。你阿媽有水用喇。

en: If you're going to point that at me, get on with it.
zh_HK: 你要影就快啲影啦，唔好喺度指住我。
咁你靜靜哋多謝自己啦。

en: I was talking to the bowl.
Sit with your grandfather. He's waited all day for that kettle.
zh_HK: 陪下你公公啦。佢成日就等住個煲水。

en: You waited all day for that.
Since Tuesday. The pump's sounded wrong since Tuesday.
zh_HK: 由禮拜二等到而家。個泵由禮拜二開始就唔妥。

en: Mr. Ho says they'll shut it off soon anyway.
zh_HK: 何師傅話，遲早都會截咗佢。

en: Then we'll drink this one slowly.
The fan turns. Somewhere below, someone is filling a bucket.
zh_HK: 風扇轉着。樓下某處，有人在裝水。

en: A brochure for the new estate. Clean towers, a playground, a family smiling on a balcony.
zh_HK: 新屋邨的宣傳單張。整齊的大廈、遊樂場，一家人在露台上笑。

en: The tap coughs air, then nothing.
zh_HK: 水龍頭咳出一口氣，然後甚麼也沒有。

en: Water: cloudy for a moment, then clear.
zh_HK: 有水了：先是有點混濁，一會兒就清了。

en: Three days of washing in a basin and not a drop to rinse it. Tell Ho I'm counting.
zh_HK: 三日嘅衫浸喺盆度，一滴過水嘅水都冇。同何師傅講，我數緊日子。

en: It's back! Where's that boy with the buckets?
zh_HK: 有水喇！嗰個衰仔同啲桶去咗邊？

en: Mr. Ng says the birds drink before people do.
zh_HK: 吳伯話啲雀要飲先過人飲。

en: The birds had the last of the tank this morning.
zh_HK: 今朝啲雀飲晒水缸最後嗰啲水。

en: No water, no patients. I can't rinse a mouth with tea.
zh_HK: 冇水就冇病人。總唔可以用茶嚟漱口。

en: No water? Then I'll have yesterday's tea. Tell your grandfather I'm managing.
zh_HK: 冇水？咁我飲尋日嘅茶。同你公公講，我搞得掂。

en: Paper says nothing about the water. Paper never says anything about us.
zh_HK: 報紙冇講停水。報紙從來都冇講過我哋。

en: No water, no soup. I've been chopping for nothing.
zh_HK: 冇水就冇湯。我斬咗成朝都係白斬。

en: There. Soup after all. Tell your grandfather.
zh_HK: 好喇，有湯飲喇。同你公公講聲。

en: No water, no work. So: mahjong.
zh_HK: 冇水開唔到工，咪打麻雀囉。

en: Water for the teahouse. Carried up from the standpipe in the street.
zh_HK: 茶樓嘅水。由街喉度擔上嚟。

en: Ma says bath today after all.
zh_HK: 阿媽話今日都係要沖涼。

en: “He'll be in the hall, talking to a pipe.”
zh_HK: 「佢應該喺走廊，同條水喉傾緊偈。」

en: “Blue branch. Follow it until it stops being blue.”
zh_HK: 「藍色嗰條支喉。跟住佢行，行到佢唔再係藍色為止。」

en: The one that knocks crosses the light well.
zh_HK: 會咚咚響的那條，橫過了天井。

en: It runs on past Mrs. Fong's, into the empty flat next door.
zh_HK: 它經過方太家，一直伸進隔壁的空屋。

en: Three valves. Only one is on the line up to the tank.
zh_HK: 三個水掣，只有一個接往天台水缸。

en: While he washes the grease off his hands.
Press [SPACE] to go on to the next day
The back kitchen window, standing open.
Mrs. Chan: “Wai! Buckets! The water's back!”
zh_HK: 陳太：「阿偉！啲桶呀！有水喇！」

en: Mrs. Fong's door. A radio is playing inside, turned low.
zh_HK: 方太的門。裡面開著收音機，聲音調得很低。

en: Chained from the outside, a Housing Department notice across it: the family has been rehoused.
zh_HK: 門從外面用鐵鏈鎖住，貼著房屋署的通告：住戶已獲安置。

en: Someone's kitchen window. Not yours to climb through.
zh_HK: 別人家的廚房窗。不是你爬的地方。

en: Pale shapes on the wall, where a wardrobe and a bed stood for years.
zh_HK: 牆上一塊塊淺色的印，是衣櫃和床多年靠過的地方。

en: The calendar stayed behind. Nobody turned it past the month they left.
zh_HK: 月曆留下了。搬走那個月之後，再沒有人翻過。

en: A stool with a leg gone, left where it fell.
zh_HK: 一張斷了腳的凳，倒在那裡沒人理。

en: The old sink. The whole family washed here: rice, clothes, faces.
zh_HK: 舊洗碗盆。一家人都在這裡洗：洗米、洗衫、洗面。

en: Planks across the well. People on this side have crossed it for years; the rail is worn smooth.
zh_HK: 橫過天井的木板橋。這邊的人走了很多年，扶手都磨滑了。

en: He says nobody built the water system. Everybody did.
zh_HK: 他說這裡的水喉沒有人建過，是大家一起建的。

en: For years there was no public water supply inside the City. Residents sank wells and pumped water up to tanks on the roofs; the pipes that brought it down were laid, and mended, by whoever needed them.
zh_HK: 多年來城寨內沒有公共供水。居民自己打井，把水泵上天台水缸；把水送下來的水喉，都是有需要的人自己鋪、自己修的。

en: Upstairs, something heavy hits a table. Again. Again.
zh_HK: 樓上有重物一下一下砸在桌上。

en: You came all the way over to be annoying?
Come on. Up the stair by the mahjong table.
zh_HK: 嚟啦。麻雀檯隔籬條樓梯上去。

en: Up the stair. He doesn't like waiting.
This is how he welcomes people.
Final shipment. Stair's blocked. Loading route's half gone.
zh_HK: 最後一批貨。樓梯塞死咗，落貨嗰條路又冇咗一半。

en: What do you need me to do?
Find me a way from here to the street that does not involve lifting twelve crates down seven flights by hand.
zh_HK: 搵條路，由呢度去到街，唔使用手捧十二箱貨落七層樓。

en: He points his chin at the ceiling: a hatch, and a hoist beam under it.
zh_HK: 他用下巴指指天花板：一個活門，下面有條吊貨的橫樑。

en: Why up if the street is down?
zh_HK: 條街喺下面，點解要向上？

en: Up the ladder. Look at what's left of the old way.
zh_HK: 爬上去。睇吓舊條路剩返啲咩。

en: The crates came up here. So where did they go?
zh_HK: 啲貨上咗嚟呢度。咁之後去咗邊？

en: Looking back from the far side: over the neighbours' balcony, a pulley on a gallows arm, and a platform hanging from it over the slot.
zh_HK: 從另一邊回頭看：鄰居露台上伸出一枝吊臂，掛著一個滑輪，下面吊著一個木板台，懸在兩座樓中間的窄縫上。

en: It'll want a rope. And something across the gap.
zh_HK: 要條繩。仲要有嘢搭過條罅。

en: A rope, something to bridge that gap, and someone who knows if that pulley's going to kill us.
zh_HK: 一條繩，一樣搭得過條罅嘅嘢，仲要有個人話我知個滑輪會唔會整死我哋。

en: Mr. Ng's got rope for his birds. Wai's been sat on a plank all week. And Ho's up top already. Ask him.
zh_HK: 吳伯養白鴿實有繩。阿偉成個禮拜都坐喺塊板度。何師傅就喺上面，問佢啦。

en: Not yet. The plank, the sign, the rope. Then me.
zh_HK: 未得。木板、招牌、條繩。之後先到我。

en: The plank across, the sign out of the way, the rope on the winch. Then I crank.
zh_HK: 搭好木板，推開招牌，穿好條繩。之後我搖。

en: Kit said there was work. I came for the tea.
zh_HK: 阿潔話有嘢做。我係嚟飲茶嘅。

en: Ho leans out over the parapet to look at the pulley.
zh_HK: 何師傅探身出女兒牆看那滑輪。
因為佢到而家都未跌落嚟。

en: It'll hold. Don't lean on it.
Busy morning upstairs. The birds don't like the pounding.
zh_HK: 樓上成朝好嘈。啲雀唔鍾意咁嘅聲。

en: Every crate in that workshop has walked past my door this week.
zh_HK: 呢個禮拜，嗰間工場啲貨箱全部喺我門口經過。
借嗰塊板嚟用吓得唔得？

en: Wai gets up. Mrs. Chan hands over the plank.
zh_HK: 阿偉站起身。陳太把木板遞過來。

en: Bring it back. It's the only shelf I haven't packed.
zh_HK: 記得還。我淨係得呢塊板未執落箱。

en: Half the laundry's in boxes already. The plank, you bring back.
zh_HK: 啲衫有一半已經入晒箱。塊板你記得拎返嚟。

en: A drop between the roof and the neighbours' balcony, all the way down to the lane.
zh_HK: 天台和鄰居露台之間是一道縫，一直落到下面的後巷。

en: The plank reaches, just. Mei puts her weight on it. It holds.
zh_HK: 木板剛好搭到。阿美踩上去試試，頂得住。

en: The neighbours' big signboard stands out from their wall, right across the balcony. No crate is getting past it.
zh_HK: 鄰居的大招牌從牆上伸出來，橫過整個露台。貨箱過不去。

en: It swings back against the wall on its hinges, stiff with rust.
zh_HK: 招牌沿著鉸位慢慢摺回牆邊，生了鏽，很緊。

en: An old hand winch on the gallows post. No rope on the drum.
zh_HK: 吊臂柱上一部舊手搖絞盤，轆上沒有繩。

en: Mr. Ng's rope, over the pulley and onto the drum. Kit takes the handle.
zh_HK: 吳伯的繩穿過滑輪，繞上絞盤。阿潔握住搖柄。

en: The platform touches down in the lane. Below, the porter swings the crate onto his shoulder.
zh_HK: 木板台落到後巷。下面的咕喱一手把貨箱托上肩。

en: By the last crate, nobody is counting out loud any more.
zh_HK: 到最後一箱，已經沒有人再數出聲了。

en: Uncle Chiu writes the new address on the last crate in thick marker.
zh_HK: 趙叔用粗墨水筆在最後一箱上寫上新地址。

en: Go on. Kit's up on the roof. I've got cleaning.
zh_HK: 去啦。阿潔喺天台。我要執嘢。

en: Lift goes all the way up.
Exactly. What do you do while it's moving?
zh_HK: 咪係囉。佢郁緊嗰陣你做咩？

en: Kit turns the key over in her fingers.
zh_HK: 阿潔用手指翻弄著那條鎖匙。

en: You know you can come over.
zh_HK: 你知㗎，你隨時可以過嚟。

en: You keep saying that like I'm moving to Canada.
zh_HK: 你次次都講到好似我搬去加拿大咁。

en: Chiu's making the whole building shake. Last batch?
zh_HK: 趙老闆搞到成座樓震。最後一批？

en: If Chiu's paying you in fish balls, I want a bag.
zh_HK: 如果趙老闆用魚蛋當人工，我要一袋。

en: Mind the floor. It's been wet since 1971.
zh_HK: 小心地下。由一九七一年濕到而家。

en: Forty years he's beaten the paste by hand. He says machines make it taste of machines.
zh_HK: 佢用手打咗四十年魚漿。佢話機器打出嚟有機器味。

en: Waiting on crates. Paid by the crate, not by the wait.
zh_HK: 等緊啲貨。按箱計錢，唔計等。

en: Chiu's going too? Then where will my patients get lunch?
zh_HK: 趙老闆都走？咁我啲病人去邊度食晏？

en: Tell your grandfather the pounding upstairs is Chiu, not his heart.
zh_HK: 同你公公講，樓上咚咚聲係趙老闆，唔係佢個心。

en: Last batch, is it? Put a bag by for me.
Chiu's paste is better than mine. Don't tell him.
zh_HK: 趙老闆啲魚漿好過我。唔好話佢知。

en: Every thump, I lose a tile.
zh_HK: 佢每咚一聲，我就輸一隻牌。

en: Chiu's crates are in the way of mine.
zh_HK: 趙老闆啲貨箱擋住我啲貨。

en: I got a fish ball for carrying a bowl!
zh_HK: 我幫手拎碗，有粒魚蛋食！

en: Up the stair beside the mahjong table.
zh_HK: 麻雀檯旁邊的樓梯上去。

en: A rope, something to bridge the gap, and someone to vouch for the pulley.
zh_HK: 一條繩、一樣搭得過縫的東西，還要有人擔保那滑輪。

en: Lay the plank. Get the sign out of the way. Rig the rope.
zh_HK: 搭好木板，移開招牌，穿好繩。

en: The ladder by the workshop door goes up through the hatch.
zh_HK: 工場門邊的梯子，經天窗通上天台。

en: From the roof, turn the view [Q] [E] and look back across the gap.
zh_HK: 在天台上，按 [Q] [E] 轉換視角，回頭望過那道縫。

en: Rope: Mr. Ng keeps some for his birds, up on the top roof.
zh_HK: 繩：吳伯養鴿要用繩，他在頂樓天台。

en: A plank: Wai has been sitting on one in the Chans' room.
zh_HK: 木板：阿偉在陳太家裏坐着一塊。

en: The pulley: ask Mr. Ho, up on the workshop roof, if it will hold.
zh_HK: 滑輪：問問工場天台上的何師傅頂不頂得住。

en: Lay the plank across the gap from the workshop roof.
zh_HK: 在工場天台把木板搭過那道縫。

en: The signboard is in the way. Turn the view to see how it's fixed to the wall.
zh_HK: 招牌擋住去路。轉換視角，看看它怎樣釘在牆上。

en: Fold the signboard back against the wall.
Rig the rope at the winch by the gallows post.
zh_HK: 在吊臂柱旁的絞盤穿好繩。

en: Uncle Chiu is writing on the last crate.
zh_HK: 趙叔在最後一箱上寫字。

en: Upstairs, Uncle Chiu's hands at the worktable, finishing the last of it.
zh_HK: 樓上，趙叔的伙計圍着工作枱，做完最後一批。

en: Up the ladder in the workshop.
Ho says the pulley will hold.
Hinges on the back of the sign: it folds flat to the wall.
zh_HK: 招牌背後有鉸：可以摺埋貼牆。

en: The lane runs out past a steel gate to the street. Deliveries come and go this way, and the rubbish.
zh_HK: 後巷穿過一道鐵閘通到街上。送貨進出都走這裡，垃圾也是。

en: The Chius' workshop door, shut. The smell of fish comes through it anyway.
zh_HK: 趙家工場的門關著。魚的味道還是從門縫透出來。

en: Up the second stair, over the hall
zh_HK: 第二條樓梯上去，走廊樓上

en: Kit's uncle says the new place has proper drains.\nKit says this is the first sensible thing he has ever said.
zh_HK: 阿潔的叔叔說新地方的渠好。\n阿潔說這是他講過最有道理的一句話。

en: Unlicensed workshops filled the lower floors, making fish balls, noodles and sweets for restaurants across Hong Kong.
zh_HK: 城寨低層擠滿無牌小工場，做魚蛋、麵和糖果，供貨給全港食肆。

en: Out through the back door by the mahjong table, along the lane, past the open gate.
zh_HK: 從麻雀枱旁的後門出去，沿後巷走，穿過打開了的鐵閘。

en: Mr. Lau: in his clinic, packing up.
Mrs. Chan and Wai: up on the roof.
Kit: at her uncle's old workshop.
zh_HK: 阿潔：在她阿叔的舊工場。

en: Mr. Cheng's cabinet: the storage room's door is too narrow. Look at the room from the side.
zh_HK: 鄭先生的櫃：貨倉的門太窄。從側面看看那房間。

en: The stair past the gap seems to end at a wall. Turn the view at the top.
zh_HK: 縫後面的樓梯好像撞牆就完。到樓梯頂轉換視角。

en: The classroom's balcony door is too narrow for a cabinet. Look at it from the balcony.
zh_HK: 課室通露台的門太窄，櫃搬不出。從露台那邊看看。

en: Unbolt the balcony door's other leaf.
zh_HK: 拉開露台門另一邊的門閂。

en: Take the addresses to Mrs. Cheung.
At her table in the yamen.
Photograph Mrs. Cheung with her address book.
zh_HK: 為張婆婆和她的地址簿拍照。

en: At her table, the book open.
Bolts on the outside of the other leaf: it folds back.
zh_HK: 另一邊門的門閂在外面：可以摺起來。

en: The album has a new line under each name: AFTER.
zh_HK: 相簿每個名字下面，多了一行：之後。

en: The yamen: the old magistrate's office, the one building left from when this was a fort. For years it has been the old people's home.
zh_HK: 衙門：從前的衙署，是寨城還是炮台時留下的唯一建築。多年來一直是老人院。

en: Two iron cannons from the old fort. Children sit on them. Nobody remembers them ever being fired.
zh_HK: 兩尊舊炮台留下的鐵炮。小朋友喜歡坐上去。沒有人記得它們開過炮。

en: The only tree Mei knows in the City. Someone waters it every morning.
zh_HK: 阿美在城寨裏認識的唯一一棵樹。每朝都有人淋水。

en: Chalk on the blackboard: 1992. THANK YOU, EVERYONE. GOODBYE.
zh_HK: 黑板上的粉筆字：一九九二年。謝謝各位。再見。

en: The yamen, the Qing magistrate's office, was all that was left of the old fort. It served as an old people's home, a school and a clinic, and was the only building kept when the City was cleared.
zh_HK: 衙門是清朝的衙署，也是舊炮台唯一留下的建築，做過老人院、學校和診所。寨城清拆時，只有它被保留下來。

en: 2/F, 27 Tak Ku Ling Road. Across the road. Two windows.
zh_HK: 德高令道二十七號二樓。對面馬路。兩個窗。

en: Block 7, Room 1406, on a fish-ball label.
zh_HK: 七座一四零六室，寫在魚蛋標籤背面。

en: Mrs. Cheung was asking for you.
The one at the yamen. With the book.
zh_HK: 衙門嗰個。拎住本簿嗰個。

en: Hers has everyone in it. The lane gate's open now. Go the back way.
zh_HK: 佢本簿入面有晒所有人。後巷道閘而家開咗，行後面啦。
劉醫生。陳太。你個朋友阿潔。

en: That is why I am asking.
By the storage room, two movers stand back from a cabinet that isn't going anywhere.
zh_HK: 貨倉門口，兩個搬運工退開兩步，望住一個搬唔郁嘅櫃。

en: Can the plan show me where?
zh_HK: 圖則可唔可以話我知喺邊？

en: Plan says it goes out the door. Door says no.
zh_HK: 圖則話由道門出。道門話唔得。

en: If you know another way out of there, miss, I would be glad to hear it.
zh_HK: 小姐，如果你知道有第二條路出嚟，我好樂意聽。

en: Not the door. Behind the shelves there's a gap between the walls.
zh_HK: 唔係道門。層架後面，兩幅牆中間有條罅。

en: Along it to the landing, up the stair, sideways into the old classroom, and out over the balcony.
zh_HK: 沿住條罅去樓梯口，上樓梯，打側入舊課室，再由露台出去。

en: The balcony door's other half opens. The bolts were on the outside.
zh_HK: 露台門另外半邊打得開㗎。門閂喺出面。

en: You know once somebody shows you.
zh_HK: 有人帶你行過一次，你就知。

en: I'm going to draw it on. In pencil.
A heavy camphorwood cabinet. A yellow label on it: C-714.
zh_HK: 一個好重嘅樟木櫃。貼住張黃色標籤：C-714。

en: One leaf of the door opens. The other was bricked up years ago. A person fits. A cabinet doesn't.
zh_HK: 道門得一邊開到，另一邊好多年前已經封咗。人過得，櫃過唔到。

en: From the side: there's a gap between this wall and the next building. And a way into it, behind the shelves.
zh_HK: 由側面睇：呢幅牆同隔籬座樓之間有條罅。層架後面有路入去。

en: It doesn't end at the wall. It goes on sideways, into the next building.
zh_HK: 唔係行到幅牆就冇路。打側仲有得行，入去隔籬座。

en: Behind the stacked desks, a doorway.
zh_HK: 疊埋嘅書枱後面，有個門口。

en: The classroom's door onto the balcony: one leaf open, the other shut fast.
zh_HK: 課室通露台嗰度門：一邊開咗，另一邊閂得實實。

en: Mei slides the bolts back. The second leaf folds flat against the wall.
zh_HK: 阿美拉開門閂。另一邊門摺埋，貼住牆。

en: She wants to know where everyone went.
Have you seen the new place?
I'm moving up in the world.
Rent's twice as much. Apparently daylight is extra.
zh_HK: 租貴一倍。原來日光係要另外收錢嘅。

en: There are cards inside the door. Take one. I had five hundred printed.
zh_HK: 門後面有卡片，攞一張啦。我印咗五百張。

en: Tell her the stairs are wider too. She'll ask.
zh_HK: 同佢講樓梯都闊啲。佢一定會問。

en: LAU DENTAL. NEW ADDRESS: 2/F, 27 Tak Ku Ling Road, Kowloon City.
zh_HK: 劉牙科。新址：九龍城德高令道二十七號二樓。

en: He's only going across the road.
zh_HK: 佢咪就係搬去對面馬路。

en: She has one already. He had five hundred printed.
zh_HK: 她已經拿了一張。他印了五百張。

en: Very observant. That camera is improving you.
zh_HK: 好眼力。部相機令你進步咗。

en: Mrs. Wong wraps a cup in newspaper.
zh_HK: 黃婆婆用報紙包起一隻杯。

en: Then perhaps you should listen to everyone occasionally.
zh_HK: 咁你間中都應該聽下人講。

en: Grandpa still thinks you're waiting for him.
Mind the boxes. The one with the cups is the one you'll trip on.
zh_HK: 小心啲箱。你一定會踢中裝杯嗰個。

en: Mrs. Cheung wants your new address.
zh_HK: 張婆婆想要你哋嘅新地址。

en: Good. Tell her there are lifts.
Everyone keeps telling me about lifts.
You say that every time stairs are involved.
zh_HK: 你次次一講到樓梯就咁講。

en: Room 1207, Block 3, On Tai Estate. Twelfth floor. With a lift.
zh_HK: 安泰邨三座一二零七室。十二樓。有𨋢。

en: Hold that end. No, the other end.
Kit writes it on the back of a fish-ball label: Block 7, Room 1406.
zh_HK: 阿潔喺一張魚蛋標籤背面寫低地址：七座一四零六室。

en: What is that supposed to mean?
You put things somewhere safe and then spend twenty minutes looking for the safe place.
zh_HK: 你將啲嘢收喺一個安全嘅地方，之後用二十分鐘搵嗰個安全嘅地方。

en: Uncle wants the keys back by six. The landlord wants them by five.
zh_HK: 阿叔要我六點前交返條鎖匙。業主要五點。

en: Three. I can count. So can you.
And my cabinet, if Mr. Cheng ever finds the way.
zh_HK: 仲有我個櫃，如果鄭先生搵到條路嘅話。

en: Mrs. Cheung copies all three addresses into her book.
zh_HK: 張婆婆把三個地址抄進簿裏。

en: Knowing where someone lived is useful.
zh_HK: 知道人哋以前住喺邊，有用。

en: Knowing where they went is better.
zh_HK: 知道佢哋搬咗去邊，更加好。

en: Get the book in. I'm not important. The book is.
zh_HK: 影埋本簿。我唔重要，本簿先重要。

en: It's the only thing in focus.
The yamen was here before any of us. It will be here after.
zh_HK: 衙門喺我哋未嚟之前已經喺度。我哋走咗之後佢都會喺度。

en: If Mrs. Cheung gives you tea, drink it. She'll ask.
zh_HK: 如果張婆婆請你飲茶，就飲咗佢。佢會問㗎。

en: It went in. It'll come out. Everything that goes in comes out.
zh_HK: 入得嚟，就出得去。入得嚟嘅嘢都出得去。

en: C-714. C-714. C-714. I'll be writing it in my sleep.
Forty years, every morning, here. The new place has a garden. On the roof.
zh_HK: 四十年，朝朝都喺度。新地方有個花園，喺天台。

en: He sings better out here. So do I.
zh_HK: 佢喺出面唱得好聽啲。我都係。

en: Everyone wants their fans fixed before they move. Nobody wants to carry a broken fan.
zh_HK: 個個都要喺搬之前整好把風扇。冇人想孭住把爛風扇走。

en: The birds know something's happening. They keep counting the roofs.
zh_HK: 啲雀知道有事發生。佢哋成日數緊啲天台。

en: Open as usual. Somebody has to be.
zh_HK: 照常營業。總要有人照常。

en: Twelve days. Then I chop somewhere else.
zh_HK: 仲有十二日。之後喺第二度斬。

en: Last game at this table is on the ninth. You're invited to lose.
zh_HK: 九號係呢張枱最後一局。歡迎你嚟輸。

en: Labels, labels. My hands smell of glue.
zh_HK: 標籤、標籤。我對手成陣膠水味。

en: Did you see the cannons? You can sit on them. They're warm.
zh_HK: 你見唔見到啲大炮？可以坐㗎。暖㗎。

en: Mum has a small box open on the floor. Nothing in it is theirs.
zh_HK: 媽媽在地上打開了一個小紙箱，裡面的東西都不是他們家的。

en: When were you planning to do it?
A folding stool. A screwdriver. A tin of birdseed. A bowl. One mahjong tile.
zh_HK: 一張摺凳、一把螺絲批、一罐雀粟、一隻碗、一隻麻雀牌。

en: And this was under your bed.
zh_HK: 仲有呢樣，喺你張床底下搵到嘅。

en: Mr. Ng's rope, still coiled the way he coils it.
zh_HK: 吳伯的繩，仍然照他的方法圈好。

en: I was going to give it back.
The stool is Mrs. Fong's, across the well. The bowl is Mrs. Wong's.
zh_HK: 張凳係方太嘅，喺天井對面。隻碗係黃婆婆嘅。

en: The tile came out of your grandfather's drawer. Don't ask me.
zh_HK: 隻牌係喺你公公個櫃桶度搵到嘅。唔好問我。

en: Mum is still sitting at the table, a bowl half-wrapped in front of her.
zh_HK: 媽媽仍然坐在桌旁，面前一隻碗包了一半。

en: He pats his shirt pocket, once, as if to check it's still there.
zh_HK: 他拍了拍襯衫口袋，好像要確定東西還在。

en: Then why did we have it for three years?
zh_HK: 咁點解我哋攞咗佢三年？
你公公借嘢，係永久咁借。

en: Mr. Ho takes it anyway, and puts it in the box with the others.
zh_HK: 何師傅還是接了過來，放進箱裡和其他工具一起。

en: Forty years of screws. I'm counting them. Don't talk to me.
zh_HK: 四十年嘅螺絲，我數緊。唔好同我講嘢。

en: Mei hands over the coiled rope.
zh_HK: 阿美把圈好的繩遞過去。

en: Mr. Ng takes it without a word.
zh_HK: 吳伯一句話也沒說，接了過去。

en: They go in boxes on Thursday. They won't like it. Neither will I.
zh_HK: 佢哋星期四入箱。佢哋唔會鍾意。我都唔會。

en: What do you mean, another one?
Mr. Tsang looks over toward Grandfather's end of the building.
zh_HK: 曾伯朝公公那邊望了一眼。

en: The other one drops it into a biscuit tin with the rest.
zh_HK: 另一個把它丟進餅罐，和其餘的放在一起。

en: Two of us left. You can't play with two. We tried.
zh_HK: 得返我哋兩個。兩個人打唔到。我哋試過。

en: Shut. First time in thirty-one years.
zh_HK: 閂咗。三十一年嚟第一次。

en: It feels like a holiday nobody wanted.
zh_HK: 好似放咗個冇人想要嘅假。

en: The door is open. Nobody is here.
Mei folds the stool and leaves it against the wall, inside the door.
zh_HK: 阿美把凳摺好，靠在門內的牆邊。

en: Mrs. Wong's room is open. The bed has been stripped; her chair is gone.
zh_HK: 黃婆婆的房門開著。床已經拆清，她的椅子也不見了。

en: Her daughter came for her early.
zh_HK: 她的女兒提早來接了她。

en: On the table, an envelope, in her writing: FOR THE OLD FOOL.
zh_HK: 桌上有個信封，是她的字：「老懵懂收」。

en: Mei puts the bowl down beside it, and takes the envelope.
zh_HK: 阿美把碗放在旁邊，拿起信封。

en: The bowl on the small table, in the empty room.
zh_HK: 空房裡，小桌上放著那隻碗。

en: Mrs. Wong left this. For you.
It counts even if my daughter dragged me.
zh_HK: 就算係我個女拉我走，都計數。

en: You said you didn't know what she meant.
He folds the note, and puts it in his shirt pocket. Not into a box.
zh_HK: 他把信摺好，放進襯衫口袋裡。不是放進箱裡。

en: Behind the pegboard, where the shop's old sign always leaned: a narrow stair, going up.
zh_HK: 洞洞板後面，舊招牌一直靠著的地方：一條窄樓梯，往上走。

en: The red bowl isn't on the shelf.
It is still there. In a box.
Every time I come back, something's gone.
zh_HK: 我每次返嚟，都有啲嘢唔見咗。

en: Can you stop for one day?
Then what are you asking me to do?
Stop making it disappear before it disappears.
zh_HK: 唔好喺啲嘢未消失之前，就令佢消失。
第五章・靜下來的房間

en: The screwdriver: Mr. Ho's, in the hall.
zh_HK: 螺絲批：何師傅的，在走廊。

en: The birdseed and the rope: Mr. Ng's, on the roof.
zh_HK: 雀粟和繩：吳伯的，在天台。

en: The mahjong tile: back to the mahjong table.
zh_HK: 麻雀牌：還給麻雀枱那邊。

en: The bowl: Mrs. Wong's, past the end of the catwalk.
zh_HK: 碗：黃婆婆的，過了天橋就是。

en: The stool: Mrs. Fong's, across the light well.
zh_HK: 摺凳：方太的，在天井對面。

en: The stool: Mrs. Fong's. The footbridge is gone. Find a way round from below: the shop at the foot of the stairs by Lau's stands open.
zh_HK: 摺凳：方太的。木板橋沒了。從下面找路繞過去：劉醫生那邊樓梯腳的舖頭開著。

en: The stool: the old metal shop is empty. Turn the view inside it.
zh_HK: 摺凳：舊五金舖已經空了。在裡面轉換視角。

en: The stool: up the narrow stair behind the pegboard, to Mrs. Fong's door.
zh_HK: 摺凳：從洞洞板後的窄樓梯上去，到方太門口。
黃婆婆的信封：交給公公。

en: Over the catwalk. The washing's gone; the pegs are still there.
zh_HK: 在天橋上方。衫已經收走，衣夾還在。

en: The screwdriver: back with Mr. Ho.
The birdseed and the rope: back with Mr. Ng.
The tile: in the tin with the rest.
zh_HK: 麻雀牌：和其餘的放進罐裡了。

en: The stool: left for Mrs. Fong.

zh_HK: 黃婆婆的信封。給公公的。

en: Chalked by the door, the way people leave word now: 方, an arrow, Lok Fu Estate, Block 3, 812.
zh_HK: 門邊用粉筆寫著，現在大家都是這樣留話的：方，一個箭嘴，樂富邨，三座，812。

en: A pegboard with every tool's outline painted round it, so each one went back in its place. Every place is empty.
zh_HK: 一塊洞洞板，每件工具的形狀都用油漆描了出來，好讓每件都放回原位。現在每個位置都空了。

en: A pale square marks where something used to hang.
zh_HK: 牆上一個淺色的方印，是從前掛東西的地方。

en: The bracket Mr. Lau's sign hung from. Without it, his stairs look like anybody's stairs.
zh_HK: 劉醫生那塊招牌的鐵架。沒了招牌，他的樓梯看起來就跟別處的樓梯一樣。

en: Mr. Kwok's shutter, pulled halfway down in the middle of the day.
zh_HK: 郭伯的鐵閘，大白天拉下了一半。

en: Mrs. Fong's tap. Mei turns it: nothing, not even a cough. They've shut the riser for this side.
zh_HK: 方太的水喉。阿美扭開：甚麼也沒有，連咳一聲也沒有。這一邊的總喉已經關了。

en: The tap over the old sink gives nothing. On this side the pipes have gone quiet.
zh_HK: 舊洗碗盆上的水喉甚麼也流不出來。這一邊的水管都靜了。

en: The mahjong table, folded flat against the wall. You can see how small it is now.
zh_HK: 麻雀枱摺平了靠在牆邊。現在才看得出它原來那麼細。

en: The Chans' line. Pegs, and no washing.
zh_HK: 陳家的晾衫繩。只有衣夾，沒有衫。

en: Where the footbridge was: two cut stubs, and a batten nailed across the gap.
zh_HK: 從前木板橋的位置：兩截切斷的鐵，缺口釘了一條木條。

en: It looks bigger without anything on it.
zh_HK: 上面甚麼都沒有，看起來反而大了。

en: With no room to dry anything indoors, washing went wherever there was air: across catwalks and light wells, on bamboo poles out of windows, over the roofs.
zh_HK: 屋裡沒有地方晾乾東西，衣服就掛在任何通風的地方：天橋上、天井裡、窗外伸出去的竹竿上、天台上。

en: I walked past the old stairs twice before I remembered he wasn't there.
zh_HK: 我在舊樓梯前走過了兩次，才記起他已經不在了。

en: When a clinic closed, a landmark went with it: people in the City gave directions by the dentists' signs.
zh_HK: 一間診所關了，一個地標也跟著沒了：城寨裡的人指路，靠的就是牙醫的招牌。

en: She wasn't there.\nShe still found a way to argue with him.
zh_HK: 她已經不在了。\n她還是找到辦法跟他鬥嘴。

en: Old people often left first: a son or daughter living outside the City came and took them, weeks before the clearance reached their floor.
zh_HK: 老人家往往最先走：住在城外的兒女來接他們，比清拆到他們那一層早好幾個星期。

en: The pipes were still there after the water stopped.
You're the one with the camera. From the old man's.
zh_HK: 你就係拎住部相機嗰個。老人家屋企嗰個。

en: My sister's moved to Lok Fu. I don't know which block.
zh_HK: 我家姐搬咗去樂富。我唔知係邊座。

en: She told Mrs. Wong. Mrs. Wong was going to tell me.
zh_HK: 佢同咗黃婆婆講。黃婆婆話會話我知。

en: Kwok will have it. Everybody left their new address with Kwok.
zh_HK: 郭伯會有。個個都將新地址留低畀郭伯。

en: Mrs. Leung needs her sister's address.
It'll be in the bundle. On the floor, behind the counter.
zh_HK: 應該喺嗰紮度。喺櫃枱後面地下。

en: Half down. The key's in a box. Which box, I couldn't tell you.
zh_HK: 拉咗一半。鎖匙喺箱入面。邊個箱，我都講唔到。

en: You're small. Go round the front and look under.
zh_HK: 你細粒。行去前面，由下面望入去。

en: Thirty-one years of other people's post. Most of it I never read.
zh_HK: 三十一年替人收信。大部分我都冇睇過。

en: Mei gets down on the floor and reaches under the shutter.
zh_HK: 阿美伏在地上，把手伸進鐵閘下面。

en: A note has slipped out of the bundle. In Mrs. Wong's hand: LEUNG'S SISTER. LOK FU, BLOCK 5, 1210.
zh_HK: 有一張字條從那紮信裡滑了出來。是黃婆婆的字：「梁太家姐：樂富，五座，一二一零。」

en: She left it with Mr. Kwok.
Block Five. I'll keep it on my hand until I find a pen.
zh_HK: 五座。我寫喺手度先，等我搵到枝筆。

en: Under the shutter: Mr. Kwok's bundle of addresses, on the floor.
zh_HK: 鐵閘下面：郭伯那紮地址，放在地上。

en: A note in Mrs. Wong's hand, for Mrs. Leung.
zh_HK: 黃婆婆寫給梁太的字條。

en: Mrs. Leung's sister: in the bundle behind Mr. Kwok's half-shut stall. Look from its front.
zh_HK: 梁太的家姐：在郭伯半關的士多裡那紮字條中。從正面看。
